title: Fig. 6: investigators releasing 'pillow balloons' in snowy field, Tremonton comparison test
description: Black-and-white comparison photograph marked 'FIG. 6' from the Blue Book Tremonton film analysis: three men in overcoats stand in a snow-covered field as a cluster of translucent 'pillow balloons' floats above them — the balloon-release test staged to compare against the objects in the Newhouse film.
